title: Food and Shopping
summary: 点餐、购物、数量表达、价格和礼貌请求。
objectives: Order food and ask about portions
Ask about size, payment and receipts
Resolve a return and stay within a budget

lessons.title: A Table for Two
lessons.subtitle: 进店、确认人数与等位
grammar: Could we have ...? 礼貌提出请求

vocabulary.example: Could we have a table for two?
I’d like rice on the side.
We need two portions of rice.

listening.title: A Table for Two
listening.transcript: We have a table outside now. If you want to sit inside, the wait is twenty minutes. Could we take the outdoor table, please?

speaking.prompt: 带一位朋友进店，询问双人桌、等位和室内座位。
speaking.sample: Could we have a table for two inside? How long is the wait?

reading.title: 进店、确认人数与等位
reading.text: Lunch starts at noon. Groups of six or more need a reservation. Smaller groups can ask for a table at the door.

writing.prompt: 写一条短信给朋友，说明打算坐哪、等多久和见面地点。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（Could we have ...? 礼貌提出请求）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.prompt: Could we ___ a table for two?
What does “table” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: Ordering a Meal
lessons.subtitle: 点餐和说明需求
grammar: I’d like + 名词；Could I have ...?

vocabulary.example: I’d like rice on the side.
We need two portions of rice.
The fitting room is over there.

listening.title: Ordering a Meal
listening.transcript: I’d like the grilled fish with rice. Could I have the sauce on the side? And just water to drink, please.

speaking.prompt: 模拟点一份主菜、一份配菜和饮料，并问清酱汁能否分开。
speaking.sample: I’d like the fish with rice. Could I have the sauce on the side, please?

reading.title: 点餐和说明需求
reading.text: Lunch set: choose one main dish and one side. Water is included. Add soup for three pounds. Please tell your server about any food allergies.

writing.prompt: 写一份英文点餐清单，用完整句子注明一项特殊要求。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（I’d like + 名词；Could I have ...?）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: I’d like 是礼貌点餐句型。

quiz.prompt: What does “side” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: How Much Rice?
lessons.subtitle: 理解可数和不可数名词
grammar: how many + 复数，how much + 不可数名词

vocabulary.example: We need two portions of rice.
I’d like rice on the side.
Could we have a table for two?

listening.title: How Much Rice?
listening.transcript: We need six eggs for the cake, but we only have four. There’s enough milk. Could you buy two eggs on your way home?

speaking.prompt: 就一次做饭练习问所需米、鸡蛋和水的量。
speaking.sample: How much rice do we need? How many eggs should I buy?

reading.title: 理解可数和不可数名词
reading.text: For two people, use one cup of rice, two carrots and a little oil. Add water before you heat the pot.

questions.q: How many carrots do you need?

writing.prompt: 写一份双人购物清单，用量词说明三种食材的数量。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（how many + 复数，how much + 不可数名词）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Water 是不可数名词，用 how much。

quiz.prompt: What does “portion” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: Can I Try It On?
lessons.subtitle: 询问尺码、试穿和颜色
grammar: this/these 区分单复数；have ... in + 尺码或颜色

vocabulary.example: The fitting room is over there.
We need two portions of rice.
I’d like rice on the side.

listening.title: Can I Try It On?
listening.transcript: Do you have this jacket in medium? We only have black in medium, but there’s a blue one in large. Can I try the black one on?

questions.q: Which jacket does the shopper try?

speaking.prompt: 向店员询问另一种颜色、尺码和能否试穿。
speaking.sample: Do you have these trousers in black? Can I try them on?

reading.title: 询问尺码、试穿和颜色
reading.text: Sale trousers come in black and grey. Grey is available in small and medium. Black is available in medium and large. The fitting room closes at six.

questions.q: Which colour is available in large?

writing.prompt: 写 45–60 词，向朋友比较两件衣服的颜色、尺码和选择理由。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（this/these 区分单复数；have ... in + 尺码或颜色）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: fitting room 在本课中指试衣间。
quiz.prompt: What does “fitting room” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: The Bill, Please
lessons.subtitle: 确认账单与支付方式
grammar: Could we ...?；pay by card / pay in cash

vocabulary.example: Could we have the bill, please?
The fitting room is over there.
We need two portions of rice.

listening.title: The Bill, Please
listening.transcript: Could we have the bill? We’d like to pay separately. That’s fine, but the card reader isn’t working today. Do you have cash?

speaking.prompt: 模拟结账，询问能否分开付、能否刷卡和是否含服务费。
speaking.sample: Could we pay separately? Is service included?

reading.title: 确认账单与支付方式
reading.text: This café accepts cash and cards. For groups of eight or more, a service charge is added. Ask the server before paying if you want separate bills.

questions.q: For which groups is service added?

writing.prompt: 写一段结账对话，包含两笔金额与一种付款方式。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（Could we ...?；pay by card / pay in cash）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.prompt: What does “bill” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: I’d Like to Return This
lessons.subtitle: 说明退换货原因
grammar: I’d like to + 动词；because 给出理由

vocabulary.example: Keep your receipt for a return.
Could we have the bill, please?
The fitting room is over there.

listening.title: I’d Like to Return This
listening.transcript: I bought these shoes yesterday, but they’re too tight. I have the receipt. Could I exchange them for a bigger size?

questions.q: Why does the customer want an exchange?

speaking.prompt: 模拟拿小票要求换大一码，并询问什么时候可以取。
speaking.sample: I’d like to exchange these shoes because they’re too tight.

reading.title: 说明退换货原因
reading.text: You can return unused items within thirty days with your receipt. Gifts can be exchanged for another size, but cash refunds go to the original buyer only.

questions.q: What document is needed for a return?

writing.prompt: 写 60–75 词的退换申请，写明物品、购买时间、问题和想要的解决方式。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（I’d like to + 动词；because 给出理由）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: I’d like to 后接动词原形。

quiz.prompt: What does “receipt” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: Weekly Challenge: Eat and Shop
lessons.subtitle: 同时完成点餐和购物任务
grammar: 复习礼貌请求、数量和付款

vocabulary.example: Our lunch budget is twenty pounds.
Keep your receipt for a return.
Could we have the bill, please?

listening.title: Weekly Challenge: Eat and Shop
listening.transcript: The soup is six pounds and the sandwich is eight. We can share one dessert for four. Water is free, so we’ll spend eighteen pounds altogether.

speaking.prompt: 你有 £20，口头为两人安排午餐，同时购买水瓶。说明取舍和总价。
speaking.sample: Two sandwiches and a bottle cost twenty pounds. Could we have two sandwiches, please?

reading.title: 同时完成点餐和购物任务
reading.text: Market lunch set: rice bowl £9, soup £5, or sandwich £7. Add a drink for £2. A reusable bottle costs £6 at the stall next door. Card payments accepted.

writing.prompt: 写 75–95 词，记录菜品数量、购物决定、总价和一句礼貌请求。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（复习礼貌请求、数量和付款）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。
